test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The most important fruit in Kinnaur is apricot. It is **__possible to get it at everyplace in huge amount__**.

options.text: found for a huge amount everywhere
found everywhere in a huge amount
found everywhere with a huge amount
find everywhere in a huge amount

solution:
The correct answer is **"found everywhere in a huge amount."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence uses **"at everyplace" **which is not grammatically correct. "Everywhere"</stro
